name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his father. He was particularly captivated by the intricate liveries and designs on the cars. This fascination led him to pursue a degree in automotive design, specializing in paint technology and surface finishing. After graduating, he worked at a high-end custom car shop where he honed his skills in applying complex paint schemes and protective coatings.

His meticulous approach and keen eye for detail quickly earned him recognition. He joined ART Grand Prix two years ago, focusing on ensuring the team's vehicles not only perform optimally but also represent the team's identity with impeccable visual appeal. Arjun is always experimenting with new paint technologies and application techniques to gain a competitive edge, believing that even the smallest improvement in aerodynamics through advanced coatings can make a difference.

Arjun is also deeply committed to sustainable practices. He actively researches and implements eco-friendly paint solutions, aiming to minimize the environmental impact of motorsport. His long-term vision is to revolutionize paint technology in the racing world, making it both high-performance and environmentally responsible.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed hair with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Arjun is of average height, with a lean build and focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with color swatches and paint formulas.
Insists on using a specific brand of microfiber cloths for polishing, claiming they produce the best finish.
Constantly humming Indian classical music while working, which he says helps him concentrate.
